#Loading Required Packages

```{r}
library(psych)
library(Hmisc)
library(tidyr)
library(dplyr)
library(summarytools)
library(tidyverse)
options(scipen = 999)
```
# Dataset
```{r}
crCrime <- read.csv("crCrime.csv")
crCrime <- crCrime %>% filter(attention >= 1)
crCrime <- crCrime %>% filter(gender < 3)
crCrime <- crCrime %>% filter(age >= 18)
crCrime <- crCrime %>% filter(engprof >= 5)
psych::describe(crCrime)
```
# Demographic Stats
```{r}
summarytools::freq(crCrime$gender) # 1 = man, 2 = Woman 

summarytools::freq(crCrime$country_origin) # 1 = Indian, 2 = American , 3 = Other (self described) 

summarytools::freq(crCrime$education) # 1 = Did not complete high school, 2= High school diploma/GED, 3 = Associates degree, 4 = Bachelor's degree, 5= Master's degree, 6 = Doctorate degree (PhD, MD), 7 =  Prefer not to say	

summarytools::freq(crCrime$employ) #1 = Student, 2=  Employed (full time or part time), 3 =  Self-employed, 4 =  Unemployed, 5 = Retired, 6 =  Prefer to self-describe.

summarytools::freq(crCrime$marital) #Single (never married) = 1, In a domestic partnership = 2, Married = 3, Widowed/Divorced/Separated = 4, Prefer to self-describe = 5

summarytools::freq(crCrime$religion) #Atheism = 1, Buddhism = 2 Christianity = 3, Hinduism= 4, Islam = 5, Jainism =6, Sikhism = 7, Judaism = 8, Zoroastrianism = 9, Prefer to self-describe = 10, Prefer not to disclose = 11

summarytools::freq(crCrime$race) # African American/Black = 1, Asian/Asian American/Pacific Islander = 2, Caucasian/White = 3, Hispanic American/Latino = 4, Native American = 5, Mixed Race/Biracial = 6, Other (please specify) = 7, Prefer not to say = 8

summarytools::freq(crCrime$ses) #1 = lowest on the ladder to 10 = being the highest on the ladder
```

# Reliabilities
```{r}
#Creativity Self Efficacy 
cse <- crCrime %>% select(starts_with("cse"), -cse_total)
psych::alpha(cse, check.keys = TRUE)
psych::omega(cse)

#Dark Personality Traits
mach <- crCrime %>% select(starts_with("mach"), -mach_total)
psych::alpha(mach)
psych::omega(mach)

narc <- crCrime %>% select(starts_with("nar"), -narc_total)
psych::alpha(narc, check.keys=TRUE)
psych::omega(narc)

sadism <- crCrime %>% select(starts_with("sad"), -sadism_total)
psych::alpha(sadism, check.keys=TRUE)
psych::omega(sadism)

psy <- crCrime %>% select(starts_with("psy"), -psych_total)
psych::alpha(psy, check.keys=TRUE)
psych::omega(psy)

#Moral Foundations Questionnaire (MFQ)
mfq <- crCrime %>% select(starts_with("MFQ"))
harm_mfq <- mfq %>% select(ends_with("H"))
psych::alpha(harm_mfq)
psych::omega(harm_mfq)

fair_mfq <- mfq %>% select(ends_with("F"))
psych::alpha(fair_mfq)
psych::omega(fair_mfq)

loyal_mfq <- mfq %>% select(ends_with("L"))
psych::alpha(loyal_mfq)
psych::omega(loyal_mfq)

auth_mfq <- mfq %>% select(ends_with("A"))
psych::alpha(auth_mfq)
psych::omega(auth_mfq)

pur_mfq <- mfq %>% select(ends_with("P"))
psych::alpha(pur_mfq)
psych::omega(pur_mfq)

ind_mfq <- mfq %>% select(ends_with("H") | ends_with("F"))
psych::alpha(ind_mfq)
psych::omega(ind_mfq)

bind_mfq <- mfq %>% select(ends_with("L") | ends_with("A") | ends_with("P"))
psych::alpha(bind_mfq)
psych::omega(bind_mfq)
```

# Correlations
```{r}
crCrime <- filter(crCrime, gender < 3, education < 7, stringsAsFactors = TRUE)

dv_means <- crCrime %>%
  transmute(
    mean_severity = rowMeans(select(., ends_with("_serious")), na.rm = TRUE),
    mean_harm     = rowMeans(select(., ends_with("_harm")), na.rm = TRUE),
    mean_sentence = rowMeans(select(., ends_with("_sentence")), na.rm = TRUE),
    mean_rehab    = rowMeans(select(., ends_with("_rehab")), na.rm = TRUE)
  )

cor_crime <- bind_cols(crCrime %>% 
  select(
    age, gender, education, ses, 
    psych_total, mach_total, narc_total, sadism_total,
    mfq_care, mfq_fair, mfq_loyalty, mfq_authority, mfq_purity,
    mfq_individualizing, mfq_bind,
    cse_total, legal), dv_means
)

library(apaTables)
apa.cor.table(
  cor_crime,
  filename = "correl_crime.doc",
  table.number = 1,
  show.conf.interval = TRUE,
  show.sig.stars = TRUE,
  landscape = TRUE
)
```

```{r}
#Histogram

      labs(
        title = paste("Histogram of", v),
        x = v,
        y = "Density"
      )
  )
}
```

# long data conversion

```{r}
library(ordinal)

crCrime <- crCrime %>%
  mutate(
    PID = factor(PID),
    gender = factor(gender),
  )


df_long <- crCrime %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = matches("^(Cr|non_Cr)"),
    names_to = c("creativity_dummy", "moral_valence", ".value"),
    names_pattern = "^(non_)?Cr(.*)_(harm|serious|sentence|rehab)$"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    moral_valence = case_match(
      tolower(moral_valence),
      "amb"  ~ "ambiguous",
      "self" ~ "self_interested",
      "sin"  ~ "sinful",
      "evil" ~ "evil"
    )
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    creativity = case_when(
      moral_valence == "ambiguous"        & Amb_shown  == 1 ~ "Creative",
      moral_valence == "ambiguous"        & Amb_shown  == 0 ~ "NonCreative",
      moral_valence == "self_interested"  & Self_shown == 1 ~ "Creative",
      moral_valence == "self_interested"  & Self_shown == 0 ~ "NonCreative",
      moral_valence == "sinful"           & Sin_shown  == 1 ~ "Creative",
      moral_valence == "sinful"           & Sin_shown  == 0 ~ "NonCreative",
      moral_valence == "evil"             & Evil_shown == 1 ~ "Creative",
      moral_valence == "evil"             & Evil_shown == 0 ~ "NonCreative"
    ),
    creativity = factor(creativity, levels = c("Creative", "NonCreative")),
    moral_valence = factor(
      moral_valence,
      levels = c("evil", "sinful", "self_interested", "ambiguous")
    ),
    severity = serious
  ) %>%
  select(-serious, -creativity_dummy) %>%
  relocate(PID, creativity, moral_valence)

df_long %>%
  filter(moral_valence == "evil") %>%
  group_by(PID) %>%
  summarise(
    all_missing = all(is.na(harm) & is.na(severity) &
                      is.na(sentence) & is.na(rehab))
  ) %>%
  filter(all_missing)

df_long <- df_long %>%
  filter(!is.na(harm) | !is.na(severity) | !is.na(sentence) | !is.na(rehab))

df_long$sentence_ord <- factor(df_long$sentence,
                              ordered = TRUE)

table(df_long$moral_valence, df_long$creativity)

psych::describe(df_long)

```

# Hypothesis testing 

# H1: Non-creative crimes will consistently receive higher ratings for severity, harm, sentencing, and rehabilitation recommendations compared to creative crimes of the same valence, across all levels of moral valence.

```{r}

# AMBIGUOUS 

df_amb <- df_long %>%filter(moral_valence == "ambiguous")

aov_amb_severity <- aov(severity ~ creativity + Error(PID/creativity), data = df_amb)
summary(aov_amb_severity)

aov_amb_harm <- aov(harm ~ creativity + Error(PID/creativity), data = df_amb)
summary(aov_amb_harm)

aov_amb_sentence <- aov(sentence ~ creativity + Error(PID/creativity), data = df_amb)
summary(aov_amb_sentence)

aov_amb_rehab <- aov(rehab ~ creativity + Error(PID/creativity), data = df_amb)
summary(aov_amb_rehab)

# Extract p-values for Ambiguous condition

extract_creativity_p <- function(aov_model) {
  s <- summary(aov_model)
  for (i in seq_along(s)) {
    tab <- s[[i]][[1]]
    if (!is.null(tab) && "creativity" %in% rownames(tab)) {
      return(tab["creativity", "Pr(>F)"])
    }
  }
  return(NA_real_)
}
p_amb <- c(
  extract_creativity_p(aov_amb_severity),
  extract_creativity_p(aov_amb_harm),
  extract_creativity_p(aov_amb_sentence),
  extract_creativity_p(aov_amb_rehab)
)

names(p_amb) <- c("severity", "harm", "sentence", "rehab")

p_amb_holm <- p.adjust(p_amb, method = "holm")

data.frame(
  DV = names(p_amb),
  p_raw = p_amb,
  p_holm = p_amb_holm
)

df_amb %>%
  group_by(creativity) %>%
  summarise(
    mean_severity = mean(severity, na.rm = TRUE),
    mean_harm = mean(harm, na.rm = TRUE),
    mean_sentence = mean(sentence, na.rm = TRUE),
    mean_rehab = mean(rehab, na.rm = TRUE),
    n = n()
  )

# SELF-INTERESTED
```

# H2a: Crimes with “evil” moral valence will receive higher ratings for severity, harmfulness, sentencing, and rehabilitation recommendations compared to crimes with other moral valences, regardless of creativity. 
# H2b: Crimes with “ambiguous” moral valence will receive lower ratings for severity, harmfulness, sentencing, and rehabilitation recommendations compared to crimes with other moral valences, regardless of creativity.
```{r}
# One-way repeated-measures MANOVA
manova_valence <- manova(cbind(severity, harm, sentence, rehab) ~ moral_valence + Error(PID/moral_valence),
                         data = df_long)

summary(manova_valence)

aov_sev <- aov(
  severity ~ moral_valence + Error(PID/moral_valence),
  data = df_long
)
summary(aov_sev)

library(emmeans)

emm_sev <- emmeans(aov_sev, ~ moral_valence)

pairs(emm_sev, adjust = "holm")

aov_harm <- aov(
  harm ~ moral_valence + Error(PID/moral_valence),
  data = df_long
)
summary(aov_harm)

emm_harm <- emmeans(aov_harm, ~ moral_valence)

pairs(emm_harm, adjust = "holm")

aov_sent <- aov(
  sentence ~ moral_valence + Error(PID/moral_valence),
  data = df_long
)
summary(aov_sent)

emm_sent <- emmeans(aov_sent, ~ moral_valence)

pairs(emm_sent, adjust = "holm")

aov_rehab <- aov(

  data = df_long
)

pairs(emm_rehab, adjust = "holm")
```

# H3: Ratings of crime severity will be predicted by sociodemographics, personality traits, moral foundations, creative self-efficacy, perceived legal knowledge, crime creativity (creative vs non-creative), moral valence (evil, sinful, self-interested, ambiguous), and the interaction between crime creativity and moral valence  

# We will be using standardized coefficients for multiple regression analyses
```{r}
library(lme4)
library(lmerTest)
library(effectsize)
library(performance)

severity1<- lmer(severity ~ age + gender +education + (1 | PID), data = df_long)

severity2<- lmer(severity ~ age + gender +education  + psych_total + mach_total + narc_total + sadism_total + mfq_individualizing + mfq_bind + (1 | PID), data = df_long)

severity3<- lmer(severity ~ age + gender +education  + psych_total + mach_total + narc_total + sadism_total  + mfq_individualizing + mfq_bind + cse_total + legal + (1 | PID), data = df_long)

severity4<- lmer(severity ~ age + gender +education  + psych_total + mach_total + narc_total + sadism_total  + mfq_individualizing + mfq_bind + cse_total + legal + creativity + moral_valence + creativity*moral_valence + (1 | PID), data = df_long)

summary(severity1)
summary(severity2)
summary(severity3)
summary(severity4)

standardize_parameters(severity1, method = "refit")
r2(severity1)

standardize_parameters(severity2, method = "refit")
r2(severity2)

standardize_parameters(severity3, method = "refit")
r2(severity3)

standardize_parameters(severity4, method = "refit")
r2(severity4)

library(sjPlot)

plot_model(severity4, 
           type = "pred", 
           terms = c("moral_valence", "creativity")) + 
  geom_line() 
```

# RQ3: What are the distinct profiles of participants who consider crimes as more harmful, severe, deserving of higher sentencing, and lower rehabilitation recommendations?

```{r}


library(tidyverse)
library(cluster)
library(hopkins)
library(factoextra)
library(NbClust)
library(fpc)

cluster_vars <- crCrime %>%
  transmute(
    mean_severity = rowMeans(select(., ends_with("serious")), na.rm = TRUE),
    mean_harm     = rowMeans(select(., ends_with("harm")), na.rm = TRUE),
    mean_sentence = rowMeans(select(., ends_with("sentence")), na.rm = TRUE),
    mean_rehab    = rowMeans(select(., ends_with("rehab")), na.rm = TRUE)
  )


scaled_cluster <- scale(cluster_vars)

#checking clusterability

set.seed(123)

hopkins_result <- hopkins(scaled_cluster)
hopkins_result

nb_result <- NbClust(
  scaled_cluster,
  distance = "euclidean",
  min.nc = 2,
  max.nc = 6,
  method = "kmeans"
)

# K-means clustering (k = 2)

set.seed(123)

km <- kmeans(
  scaled_cluster,
  centers = 2,
  nstart = 50
)

cluster_vars$Cluster <- factor(km$cluster)

# Attach cluster membership to participant data
cluster_profiles <- crCrime %>%
  mutate(Cluster = factor(km$cluster))

#  Cluster evaluation

# Cluster sizes
table(cluster_vars$Cluster)

# Cluster centers
km$centers

# PCA visualization
pca <- prcomp(scaled_cluster)

pca_df <- data.frame(
  PC1 = pca$x[,1],
  PC2 = pca$x[,2],
  Cluster = cluster_vars$Cluster
)

ggplot(
  pca_df,
  aes(PC1, PC2, color = Cluster)
) +
  geom_point(size = 2) +
  theme_minimal() +
  labs(
    title = "Crime Judgment Clusters (k = 2)"
  )

# Silhouette plot
sil <- silhouette(
  km$cluster,
  dist(scaled_cluster)
)

fviz_silhouette(sil)

# Cluster visualization
fviz_cluster(
  km,
  data = scaled_cluster,
  ellipse.type = "norm",
  geom = "point"
)

# Interpret crime judgment clusters

cluster_summary <- cluster_vars %>%
  group_by(Cluster) %>%
  summarise(
    Severity = mean(mean_severity),
    Harm = mean(mean_harm),
    Sentence = mean(mean_sentence),
    Rehab = mean(mean_rehab),
    n = n(),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

cluster_summary

# Profile plot
cluster_plot <- cluster_vars %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = mean_severity:mean_rehab,
    names_to = "Outcome",
    values_to = "Value"
  ) %>%
  group_by(Cluster, Outcome) %>%
  summarise(
    Value = mean(Value),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

ggplot(
  cluster_plot,
  aes(
    x = Outcome,
    y = Value,
    group = Cluster,
    color = Cluster
  )
) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 1.2) +
  geom_point(size = 3) +
  theme_minimal() +
  labs(
    title = "Crime Judgment Profiles",
    x = "Outcome Measure",
    y = "Mean Rating"
  )


library(fpc)

# Dunn Index

stats_k2 <- cluster.stats(
  d = dist(scaled_cluster),
  clustering = km$cluster
)

stats_k2$dunn


# Statistical validation of cluster differences

manova_cluster <- manova(
  cbind(
    mean_severity,
    mean_harm,
    mean_sentence,
    mean_rehab
  ) ~ Cluster,
  data = cluster_vars
)

summary(manova_cluster)
summary.aov(manova_cluster)

# Psychological profiling of clusters

profile_summary <- cluster_profiles %>%
  group_by(Cluster) %>%
  summarise(
    psych = mean(psych_total, na.rm = TRUE),
    mach = mean(mach_total, na.rm = TRUE),
    narc = mean(narc_total, na.rm = TRUE),
    sadism = mean(sadism_total, na.rm = TRUE),

    individualizing = mean(mfq_individualizing, na.rm = TRUE),
    binding = mean(mfq_bind, na.rm = TRUE),

    legal = mean(legal, na.rm = TRUE),
    cse = mean(cse_total, na.rm = TRUE),

    .groups = "drop"
  )

profile_summary

# MANOVA

manova_profiles <- manova(
  cbind(
    psych_total,
    mach_total,
    narc_total,
    sadism_total,
    mfq_individualizing,
    mfq_bind,
    legal,
    cse_total
  ) ~ Cluster,
  data = cluster_profiles
)

summary(manova_profiles)
summary.aov(manova_profiles)

# t-tests

t.test(psych_total ~ Cluster, data = cluster_profiles)
t.test(mach_total ~ Cluster, data = cluster_profiles)
t.test(narc_total ~ Cluster, data = cluster_profiles)
t.test(sadism_total ~ Cluster, data = cluster_profiles)
t.test(mfq_bind ~ Cluster, data = cluster_profiles)
t.test(mfq_individualizing ~ Cluster, data = cluster_profiles)
t.test(legal ~ Cluster, data = cluster_profiles)
t.test(cse_total ~ Cluster, data = cluster_profiles)

# Holm correction

pvals <- c(
  t.test(psych_total ~ Cluster, data = cluster_profiles)$p.value,
  t.test(mach_total ~ Cluster, data = cluster_profiles)$p.value,
  t.test(narc_total ~ Cluster, data = cluster_profiles)$p.value,
  t.test(sadism_total ~ Cluster, data = cluster_profiles)$p.value,
  t.test(mfq_individualizing ~ Cluster, data = cluster_profiles)$p.value,
  t.test(mfq_bind ~ Cluster, data = cluster_profiles)$p.value,
  t.test(legal ~ Cluster, data = cluster_profiles)$p.value,
  t.test(cse_total ~ Cluster, data = cluster_profiles)$p.value
)

p.adjust(pvals, method = "BH")

#  Psychological profile plot

profile_scaled <- cluster_profiles %>%
  select(
    Cluster,
    psych_total,
    mach_total,
    narc_total,
    sadism_total,
    mfq_individualizing,
    mfq_bind,
    legal,
    cse_total
  ) %>%
  mutate(across(-Cluster, scale))

profile_long <- profile_scaled %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = -Cluster,
    names_to = "Variable",
    values_to = "Score"
  )

ggplot(
  profile_long,
  aes(
    x = Variable,
    y = Score,
    group = Cluster,
    color = Cluster
  )
) +
  stat_summary(
    fun = mean,
    geom = "line",
    linewidth = 1.2
  ) +
  stat_summary(
    fun = mean,
    geom = "point",
    size = 3
  ) +
  theme_minimal() +
  labs(
    title = "Psychological Profiles of Crime Judgment Clusters",
    x = "Psychological Variables",
    y = "Standardized Mean (z-score)"
  ) +
  theme(
    axis.text.x = element_text(
      angle = 45,
      hjust = 1
    )
  )

# Psychological heatmap

heatmap_data <- profile_scaled %>%
  group_by(Cluster) %>%
  summarise(
    across(everything(), mean, na.rm = TRUE)
  )

heatmap_long <- heatmap_data %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = -Cluster,
    names_to = "Variable",
    values_to = "Score"
  )

ggplot(
  heatmap_long,
  aes(
    x = Variable,
    y = Cluster,
    fill = Score
  )
) +
  geom_tile(color = "white") +
  scale_fill_gradient2(
    low = "blue",
    mid = "white",
    high = "red",
    midpoint = 0
  ) +
  scale_x_discrete(
    labels = c(
      cse_total = "Creative Self-Efficacy",
      legal = "Legal Knowledge",
      mach_total = "Machiavellianism",
      mfq_bind = "Binding Foundations",
      mfq_individualizing = "Individualizing Foundations",
      narc_total = "Narcissism",
      psych_total = "Psychopathy",
      sadism_total = "Sadism"
    )
  ) +
  theme_minimal() +
  labs(
    title = "Cluster Heatmap for the Psychological Traits Associated with Crime Judgments",
    x = "",
    y = "Cluster"
  ) +
  theme(
    axis.text.x = element_text(
      angle = 45,
      hjust = 1
    )
  )
```

```{r}
      mfq_bind = "Binding Foundations",
      mfq_individualizing = "Individualizing nFoundations",
      narc_total = "Narcissism",
      psych_total = "Psychopathy",
      sadism_total = "Sadism"
    )
  ) +
  theme_minimal() +
  labs(
    title = "Psychological Traits Associated with Judgment of non-Creative Crimes",
    x = "",

  theme(

    )
  )
```

# Measurement Invariance for Robustness Check
```{r}
library(semTools)
library(lavaan)

# Data for the scales
MI_cse <- crCrime %>%
  filter(country_origin %in% c(1, 2)) %>%
  select(country_origin, cse1:cse6_r)

MI_cse$country_origin <- factor(MI_cse$country_origin)

cse_model <- '
CSE =~ cse1 + cse2 + cse3_r + cse4 + cse5 + cse6_r
'

measurementInvariance(
  model = cse_model,
  data = MI_cse,
  group = "country_origin",
  strict = FALSE
)
MI_SD4 <- crCrime %>%
  filter(country_origin %in% c(1, 2)) %>%
  select(country_origin, mach1:sadism7)
MI_SD4$country_origin <- factor(MI_SD4$country_origin)

SD4_model<- 'Machiavellianism =~ mach1 + mach2 + mach3 + mach4 + mach5 + mach6 + mach7
Narcissism =~ narc1 + narc2 + narc3 +narc4 + narc5 + narc6 + narc7 
Psychopathy =~ psy1 + psy2 + psy3 +psy4 + psy5 + psy6 + psy7 
Sadism =~ sadism1 + sadism2 + sadism3 + sadism4 + sadism5 +sadism6 +sadism7'

measurementInvariance(model = SD4_model, 
                      data = MI_SD4, 
                      group = "country_origin", 
                      strict = FALSE)

MI_mfq <- crCrime %>%
  filter(country_origin %in% c(1, 2)) %>%
  select(country_origin, MFQ_1_H:MFQ_32_P)
MI_mfq$country_origin <- factor(MI_mfq$country_origin)

mfq_model <- 'Harm =~ MFQ_1_H + MFQ_7_H + MFQ_12_H + MFQ_17_H + MFQ_23_H + MFQ_28_H
Fairness =~ MFQ_2_F + MFQ_8_F + MFQ_13_F + MFQ_18_F + MFQ_24_F + MFQ_29_F
Loyalty =~ MFQ_3_L + MFQ_9_L + MFQ_14_L + MFQ_19_L + MFQ_25_L + MFQ_30_L
Authority =~ MFQ_4_A + MFQ_10_A + MFQ_15_A + MFQ_20_A + MFQ_26_A + MFQ_31_A
Purity =~ MFQ_5_P + MFQ_11_P + MFQ_16_P + MFQ_21_P + MFQ_27_P + MFQ_32_P
'

measurementInvariance(model = mfq_model, 
                      data = MI_mfq, 
                      group = "country_origin", 
                      strict = FALSE)


fit_config <- cfa(
  mfq_model,
  data = MI_mfq,
  group = "country_origin",
  missing = "fiml",
  estimator = "MLR"
)

summary(fit_config, fit.measures = TRUE)

lavInspect(fit_config, "cor.lv")

mfq_model2<- 'Individualizing =~ MFQ_1_H + MFQ_7_H + MFQ_12_H + MFQ_17_H + MFQ_23_H + MFQ_28_H + MFQ_2_F + MFQ_8_F + MFQ_13_F + MFQ_18_F + MFQ_24_F + MFQ_29_F
Binding =~ MFQ_3_L + MFQ_9_L + MFQ_14_L + MFQ_19_L + MFQ_25_L + MFQ_30_L + MFQ_4_A + MFQ_10_A + MFQ_15_A + MFQ_20_A + MFQ_26_A + MFQ_31_A + MFQ_5_P + MFQ_11_P + MFQ_16_P + MFQ_21_P + MFQ_27_P + MFQ_32_P'

measurementInvariance(model = mfq_model2, 
                      data = MI_mfq, 
                      group = "country_origin", 
                      strict = FALSE)
```
